programme.desc: Dimitri is Fish Captain in Trouville-sur-Mer, Normandy. accompanied with his deckhands, Joris and Omar, embarked on a trawler, they track fishes… Far from their families from Monday to Friday, in the harshness of the job, they face the whims of the sea. Welcome aboard of “La Persévérance

programme.title: Back To Berlin
programme.desc: Back to Berlin is the first biker flick-meets-holocaust feature documentary. Eleven motor bikers have a mission to take the Maccabiah torch from Israel to the site of the infamous 1936 Berlin Olympics, for the first Jewish Olympic Games on German soil. They will retrace the heroic journeys of the original 1930s' Maccabiah riders and discover how they or their families survived the Holocaust.

programme.title: Black And Arab
programme.desc: Nareeman Dosa - Saudi-born, and of Sudanese heritage, - grew up in the Arab world experiencing the casual racism that most Black Arabs face. In Black and Arab, she visits Tunisia, the first Arab country to have made racial discrimination a criminal offence, embarking on a journey to explore whether the law can alter deep-rooted prejudice, as well as speaking to other Black Arabs for whom racism has been a sadly pervasive part of their existence.

programme.title: The Opium War
programme.desc: Thousands of young people are dying from using drugs in Kachin State, Myanmar. When the government is not doing enough to crack down drugs problem, the civilians formed the anti-drugs organization called “Pat Jasan” which means “Stop and Clean the drugs” in local Kachin Language, to eradicate drugs. A clash between “Pa Jasan” groups and drugs lords occurred.

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: When a talented young filmmaker tells the story of his country with compassion, beauty, and warmth in an honest, straight and raw first-person account of the war in Gaza in the summer of 2014. Mohamed Jabaly, a young man from the Gaza City, joins an ambulance crew as war approaches, looking for his place in a country under siege. While thousands of things are published on the recurring violence, the stories behind them remain hidden. Not this one. The ambulace team is led by captain Abu Marzouq who saved lives in many of Gaza's wars.

programme.title: MOMA - Moments of Modern Art
programme.desc: Moments of Modern Art is a special feature, showcasing incredible works of art and design. From sculptures to tattoos, photography to smartphone art, learn what inspires artists and designers, have a glance into the world of contemporary art and be uplifted by the dedication they have to their craft. With stories from all over the world, this is more than a show about art and design; this is a way of living!

programme.title: Crimes Of The Future
programme.desc: Through conversations with an array of Norwegian writers, filmmakers, psychiatrists, artists and more, Izquierdo investigates the impact of both the film and novel on generations of Norwegian culture and artistic practice, while exploring how it could speak about what it means to be an artist today.

programme.title: Undercover Jihadi
programme.desc: Each time a young man leaves a quiet suburb to join ISIS, we are shocked. Why do they do it? How can they be stopped? And if they come back, what to do about them? These are the questions that drive Mubin Shaikh on his quest to stop potential jihadis. Mubin went from militant extremist to undercover operative. Now a Counter-Terrorism expert, he takes to the frontlines of the battle against violent extremism around the world.

programme.title: The Middle Way
programme.desc: The Middle Way is the story of Jam Alker's childhood of trauma-abuse, neglect, and abandonment-and how he tried valiantly to overcome it. Through interviews and archival footage, this documentary traces how Alker's tumultuous upbringing drove him to pursue false idols in adulthood-money, fame, women-until he discovered the ultimate painkiller for wounds both physical and emotional: heroin. In interviews, Alker, his wife, and his bandmates recount how a new life began for Alker once he surrendered to his addiction-exploring in detail the trauma that was at the root of it. Alker's journey toward redemption was catalyzed by music, which healed him and helped him find his purpose. After a life lived in relentless pursuit of self-gratification, Alker discovered that music and his gift for storytelling could create a platform for him to serve and inspire others-and that's where the magic of true healing lies.

programme.title: Dreams From The Outback
programme.desc: The Kimberley in West Australia is home to various Aboriginal communities, where today most is in transition causing limbo and distress. Some has given up; others choose to fight both past and present demons to bring a change for the better to their people. In 'Dreams from the Outback' best friends Gabriel and Peter try to keep the ancient cultural traditions alive, with almost no support from the rest of their community. Felicity struggles to keep her family together after years of drinking and neglect and teeenagers Billy and Jordan are brothers who meet for the first time. The boys spend the days getting to know each other, exploring the outback and their culture.

programme.title: Crimes Of The Future

programme.title: Undercover Jihadi
programme.desc: Each time a young man leaves a quiet suburb to join ISIS, we are shocked. Why do they do it? How can they be stopped? And if they come back, what to do about them? These are the questions that drive Mubin Shaikh on his quest to stop potential jihadis. Mubin went from militant extremist to undercover operative. Now a Counter-Terrorism expert, he takes to the frontlines of the battle against violent extremism around the world.

programme.title: The Middle Way
programme.desc: The Middle Way is the story of Jam Alker's childhood of trauma-abuse, neglect, and abandonment-and how he tried valiantly to overcome it. Through interviews and archival footage, this documentary traces how Alker's tumultuous upbringing drove him to pursue false idols in adulthood-money, fame, women-until he discovered the ultimate painkiller for wounds both physical and emotional: heroin. In interviews, Alker, his wife, and his bandmates recount how a new life began for Alker once he surrendered to his addiction-exploring in detail the trauma that was at the root of it. Alker's journey toward redemption was catalyzed by music, which healed him and helped him find his purpose. programme.title: Touching The Sound
programme.desc: Nobuyuki Tsujii, a blind Japanese pianist, becomes a symbol of hope for people with disabilities as he performs across the world. Miraculous story of Japanese pianist blind from birth, who has become a symbol of Hope for all those with disabilities, hurdles to overcome, and problems in life. Performing throughout the world as a musical ambassador for his country, Nobuyuki Tsujii, or 'Nobu' as he is called by millions on fans with 'Nobu Fever', his is a story about the power of music.

programme.title: The Huddle
programme.desc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century. The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football. Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish.

programme.title: The Legendary Marion Williams
programme.desc: Marion Williams was an American Gospel Icon whose charismatic sound and unique “whaling” vocal techniques earned her international fame in the United States, Europe, and Africa. Marion’s powerful voice led the Ward Singers to national popularity when they began recording in 1948, and also inspired rock and roll pioneer Little Richard's signature wail.

programme.title: The Film Justifies The Means
programme.desc: Inside our dark editing rooms, we discover images filmed by a generation of filmmakers that reveal the reality of a country in conflict. Five decades later, we recover fragments of a cinematic memory that refuses to disappear.

programme.title: Twisted Tales - The Wolf
programme.desc: We explore the terrifying myths and harsh realities surroundingwolves. Long feared as savage killers and vilified in stories from Little Red Riding Hood to Hollywood's werevolves, wolves are also respected in many cultures for their intelligence and social bonds. Discover the true nature of these misunderstood animals, their rold in the ecosystem.

programme.title: True or False
programme.desc: It is the most serious scandal ever hitting the modern art market. An affair that has made experts and auction houses tremble and has re-proposed the ghost of forgery. The facts date back to 2017 in Genoa, where an exhibition dedicated to the painter Amedeo Modigliani from Livorno was closed by the Public Prosecutor’s Office, which put 21 paintings out of the 60 on display under seizure.

programme.title: The Silent Scream
programme.desc: Since thirty years the data on the glaciers melting are truly alarming .There are men who have dedicated most of their lives to glaciers, photographing, measuring and monitoring them. This documentary collects their testimonies, bringing more awareness about the current state of glaciers and our mountains

programme.title: Unknown Distance
programme.desc: After five tours and ten years as a Marine Sniper, Sergeant Douglas Brown, alongside director and producer Gordon Clark, takes us on an emotional journey across America, documenting the powerful testimony of returning combat veterans - all trained with a deadly skill set, now rendered useless. How do these soldiers fit back into a society that supported them when they enlisted but became ambivalent when they returned?

programme.title: DIY Country
programme.desc: In Spring 2014, armed pro-Russian rebels stormed the city of Donetsk in eastern Ukraine. After seizing control of the city, the separatists held a referendum - labelled illegal by the US and EU - and independence from Kiev was declared. This brave documentary explores the origins and evolution of the Donetsk People's Republic, diving into hopeful beginnings and eventual descent into enduring conflict.

programme.title: Discover China - Taoism and Buddhism
programme.desc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. Emei Mountain is a religious center for many sects of Chinese Buddhism. Long ago, it was the battleground where Buddhism clashed with one of China's leading religious at that time, Taoism.

programme.title: Russian Laundering
programme.desc: “Money mules” are people lured on the Internet and forced to launder money for hacker gangs and organized crime. Apparently serious jobs offers which become a nightmare. The documentary follows the money flow from Switzerland to Russia.

programme.title: Banzai Switzerland
programme.desc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July. Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only. Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people. Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general.

programme.title: Origin of the Species
programme.desc: Abigail Child has been at the vanguard of experimental media since the 1980s. In her latest project, she offers viewers an eerie look into the present and future of AI, through the perspectives of scientists, entrepreneurs and a Black lesbian robot. Child’s thought-provoking film considers the emerging technology’s ethical and emotional implications, presenting a speculative, not-too-distant future grounded in sci-fi.

programme.title: Grit
programme.desc: When Dian was six she narrowly escaped a tsunami of boiling mud that completely submerged 16 villages under a moonscape of grit, leaving 60,000 people displaced. Lapindo, an Indonesian drilling company, had unleashed a violent, unstoppable flow from the earth's depths, estimated to continue for another decade. Shot over six years, GRIT witnesses Dian's transformation in to a politically active teen, as she and her mother take on the perpetrators.

programme.title: Kabul, Just Before Darkness
programme.desc: A Swiss Italian television crew was in Kabul in the days leading up to the surrender and was able to document the growing anguish of a society that feels the end of a hope cultivated for twenty years. Social, civil and democratic achievements, especially those made by women, are being swept away. It is also the starting point for a reflection on the fight against terrorism.

programme.title: Messages from the End of the World
programme.desc: The documentary describes the dramatic consequences of the climate change in the Arctic zone. Thanks to the Swiss Arctic Project five young people have been navigating for three weeks through hostile and beautiful landscapes up to the North. They have documented the signs of global warming and raise the new generation’s awareness through social networks.

programme.title: Echoes Of The Empire: Beyond Genghis
programme.desc: Mongolia: for most of us, it brings to mind Genghis Khan's mighty empire. But in the present day, there is also a rich culture in the nation that grew from the ashes of Genghis Khan's triumphs, and a complex history aside from the bloodshed and conquest. A stunning cinematic view of the country's past and present, from the remarkable evolution of the Mongol Empire to intimate portraits of today’s Mongolians.

programme.title: Where to Miss
programme.desc: In the sprawling, noisy madness of Delhi, Devki battles to achieve her dream - to become a taxi driver. Within a city shaken by the bus rape of 2012, Devki strives to have the best that life can offer her. Her journey is anything but smooth.

programme.title: Stepping Out
programme.desc: China is usually seen through the lens of economics, politics and a regimented population. But in Stepping Out we meet people who have left home and set out on the road to discover their China and themselves. Su Min, who feels she has done her duty as daughter, wife, mother and grandmother and in her 50’s left her abusive husband; Kiwi, a two-year-old whose parents lost their jobs in the pandemic and not owning a house, travel China in their RV as a family; and Alex a graphic designer exploring his country with his retired mother. Through their travels and their lives, we see a different life in China – a freedom to travel, explore, visit amazing places but taking all the benefits of technology to promote themselves and make a living. The film was made in July 2022 by students from CUC Nanjing and is directed by their tutor.

programme.title: Milan, Everyone At Home
programme.desc: It’s a hot Sunday in March in Milan, when Claudio Rizzotti, freelance filmmaker, decides to take his camera to document what is beginning to happen around him. It is the beginning of the Italian lockdown for the Covid 19 pandemic and so his city, his friends and his family sink into a long lethargy.

programme.title: The Great Awakening: QAnon
programme.desc: The far-right political movement known as QAnon has taken off around the world, mobilising a committed band of believers dedicated to fighting what they claim is an ‘online war’ against corrupt, child abusing elites. In the United States, the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has declared QAnon a potential domestic terrorism threat. For one family, QAnon has caused division so severe that they had to report their relative - Tim Stewart, a QAnon conspiracy theorist - to Australia's national security hotline. In a concerning twist, it emerged that Stewart has had a longstanding friendship with Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison - leading to speculation about QAnon and Australia's highest ranks of political power. A look at the alarming movement which has caused ripples through the world, through the eyes of one family.

programme.title: Sheltered
programme.desc: In the busy world of the animal shelter, the loving bond between humans and animals is strained by the endless stream of abandoned cats, dogs, and rabbits. Pets are life companions - but for some, they are dispensable. With care and training by the passionate employees and dedicated volunteers, the hopeful animals are rehabilitated. Not every story has a happy ending, but the team fights on - even for the biggest misfits of them all.

programme.title: The Neutral Ground
programme.desc: In 2015, CJ Hunt was filming the New Orleans City Council’s vote to remove four confederate monuments from the city. A forceful group of critics protested the decision and fearing retaliation, no crew would agree to remove the statues. CJ sets out to understand why a losing army from 1865 still holds so much power in America. At once funny and furious, this film documents the USA's troubled romance with the Lost Cause.

programme.title: Man Up
programme.desc: Man Up! offers a critical look at the powerful role men can play in bringing about change within their homes and communities in order to lead more gender equitable and fulfilling lives. The film follows Sikhangele Mabulu and Monwabisi Mbetane as they reflect on their childhood socialization that has made violence an acceptable form of male expression.

programme.title: About the War
programme.desc: A reflection on war, on what the human being is capable of doing and on the job of reporter at the front. Fourteen years after recounting the conflict that shook Lebanon in 2006, Gianluca Grossi returns to the Land of the Cedars to confront a question that, over time,has become increasingly cumbersome: «What have I been used for? What is my job for? ».

programme.title: Greenwashing
programme.desc: It's a term that's come to the fore in recent years, as the urgency of the climate crisis becomes increasingly apparent. "Greenwashing" is a troubling phenomenon in which companies which brand themselves as 'sustainable' - in hopes of attracting green investment - continue to cause massive pollution. For the corporations responsible for a vast proportion of global emissions, just what lies behind the promises of climate action?

programme.title: Mr Fish: Cartooning From The Deep End
programme.desc: A personal documentary that follows a controversial political cartoonist as he struggles to provide for his family and stay true to his creativity in a world where biting satiric humor has an ever-diminishing commercial value.

programme.title: Where The Light Shines
programme.desc: Afghanistan's first ski team reach for a brighter future Where the Light ShinesFrom their amateur efforts at home in the Bamyan peaks, Sajjad and Alishah have the chance to ski for Afghanistan in the Winter Olympics. As local kids strap wood to their feet and imitate their heroes, the men face up to the difficulty of creating opportunities in a country that for generations has only seen war. Filmed over four years, this beautiful film paints an uplifting and refreshing portrait of Afghanistan as you haven't seen it before.

programme.title: Twisted Tales - The Butterfly
programme.desc: We uncover the hidden stories behind the butterfly'senchanting beauty. From their tough beginnings as caterpillars to the mysterious nocturnal lives of moths, discover how these creatures are more than just delicate beauties. Explore their fascinating transformation and cultural myths in this captivating episode.

programme.title: Discover China - The Emperor's Fantasy
programme.desc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

programme.title: In the Starlight
programme.desc: In the Starlight is an intimate portrayal about the life of nature photographer Paul Zizka and his quest to capture the night skies.

programme.title: Immersion
programme.desc: The darkness, the muffled noises, holding your breath until the very last minute: this documentary plunges into the world of free diving. Lakes, rivers, oceans - the abyss is a source of fascination for Igor. Travelling from Switzerland to the world’s deepest blue hole in the Caribbean, Igor starts to compete and is crowned Swiss champion of free diving, descending to 82 metres.

programme.title: I Am Miriam Bin Laden
programme.desc: Mariam Bin Laden is going to swim across the English Channel. This represents not only an athletic challenge, but a symbolic and ardent dream: to give a second chance to her family, to inspire and empower Arab women to go after their dreams, as well as promote awareness for one of the most important issues of our time, refugees in dire need who are forced everyday to cross boundaries to survive.

programme.title: Mariupol: The Chronicles of Hell
programme.desc: Mariupol - ruined but not conquered. The city in the east of Ukraine has survived the occupation, total destruction, and a humanitarian catastrophe. The story of Mariupol is an especially horrifying one, with accounts reported that occupiers were murdering civilians, and actively preventing them from escaping. This film is the story of the survivors, and their life in a hell on Earth. Yet it's also a testament to the power of resilience, and Ukrainian fighting spirit.

It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

programme.title: In the Starlight
programme.desc: In the Starlight is an intimate portrayal about the life of nature photographer Paul Zizka and his quest to capture the night skies.

programme.title: Immersion
programme.desc: The darkness, the muffled noises, holding your breath until the very last minute: this documentary plunges into the world of free diving. Lakes, rivers, oceans - the abyss is a source of fascination for Igor. Travelling from Switzerland to the world’s deepest blue hole in the Caribbean, Igor starts to compete and is crowned Swiss champion of free diving, descending to 82 metres.

programme.title: I Am Miriam Bin Laden
programme.desc: Mariam Bin Laden is going to swim across the English Channel. This represents not only an athletic challenge, but a symbolic and ardent dream: to give a second chance to her family, to inspire and empower Arab women to go after their dreams, as well as promote awareness for one of the most important issues of our time, refugees in dire need who are forced everyday to cross boundaries to survive.

programme.title: Mariupol: The Chronicles of Hell
programme.desc: Mariupol - ruined but not conquered. The city in the east of Ukraine has survived the occupation, total destruction, and a humanitarian catastrophe. The story of Mariupol is an especially horrifying one, with accounts reported that occupiers were murdering civilians, and actively preventing them from escaping. This film is the story of the survivors, and their life in a hell on Earth. Yet it's also a testament to the power of resilience, and Ukrainian fighting spirit.

programme.title: Twisted Tales - The Butterfly
programme.desc: We uncover the hidden stories behind the butterfly'senchanting beauty. From their tough beginnings as caterpillars to the mysterious nocturnal lives of moths, discover how these creatures are more than just delicate beauties. Explore their fascinating transformation and cultural myths in this captivating episode.

programme.title: War Peace
programme.desc: War/Peace documentary film is re-introducing the radical student activists from the late 60s. Ex-leaders of The Weather Underground movement Bill Ayers and Bernardine Dohrn. For decades the government and press have tried their best to silence them. This film will serve as an historical reminder of what happened the last time a group of young minds planned to take over an unpopular government in Washington.

programme.title: A Gentleman Thief
programme.desc: Vincenzo Pipino is a thief, he was convicted and has done over 25 years in prison both in Italy and in the rest of Europe and has expiated his faults. The documentary tells the story of this last gentleman thief.

programme.title: Angel of Nanjing
programme.desc: The Yangtze River Bridge in Nanjing is the most popular place in the world to commit suicide, with over 5 attempts per week. For the past 11 years, blue-collar worker Chen Si has been patrolling this bridge every day, watching out for desperate people who've gone there to end their lives. With no formal training, he has saved over 300 people since he began; earning him the nickname the 'Angel of Nanjing'.

programme.title: We could be Heroes
programme.desc: Though Azzedine is a Paralympic champion, at home in Morocco, he is an outcast. Denied a salary or social care, even the right to train in the city stadium, Azzedine and his friend Yousef prepare for the next Paralympic Games in Rio, where they will be going for glory in the seated shot put. Returning from Rio after a golden performance, Azzedine hopes for a hero's welcome, but instead he must fight for his basic human rights.

programme.title: Twisted Tales - The Wolf
programme.desc: We explore the terrifying myths and harsh realities surroundingwolves. Long feared as savage killers and vilified in stories from Little Red Riding Hood to Hollywood's werevolves, wolves are also respected in many cultures for their intelligence and social bonds. Discover the true nature of these misunderstood animals, their rold in the ecosystem.

programme.title: True or False
programme.desc: It is the most serious scandal ever hitting the modern art market. An affair that has made experts and auction houses tremble and has re-proposed the ghost of forgery. The facts date back to 2017 in Genoa, where an exhibition dedicated to the painter Amedeo Modigliani from Livorno was closed by the Public Prosecutor’s Office, which put 21 paintings out of the 60 on display under seizure.

programme.title: The Silent Scream
programme.desc: Since thirty years the data on the glaciers melting are truly alarming .There are men who have dedicated most of their lives to glaciers, photographing, measuring and monitoring them. This documentary collects their testimonies, bringing more awareness about the current state of glaciers and our mountains

programme.title: Unknown Distance
programme.desc: After five tours and ten years as a Marine Sniper, Sergeant Douglas Brown, alongside director and producer Gordon Clark, takes us on an emotional journey across America, documenting the powerful testimony of returning combat veterans - all trained with a deadly skill set, now rendered useless. How do these soldiers fit back into a society that supported them when they enlisted but became ambivalent when they returned?

programme.title: DIY Country
programme.desc: In Spring 2014, armed pro-Russian rebels stormed the city of Donetsk in eastern Ukraine. After seizing control of the city, the separatists held a referendum - labelled illegal by the US and EU - and independence from Kiev was declared. This brave documentary explores the origins and evolution of the Donetsk People's Republic, diving into hopeful beginnings and eventual descent into enduring conflict.

Amazing Spa Towns Of Europe
programme.desc: Wiesbaden is the final stop on Ellen’s tour, where she is stunned by amazing thermal buildings, and delighted by a visit to a famous cake shop. She discovers a naked spa and meets a Wine Princess.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: The boys are on the road and rolling into the Finger Lakes. Ride along with them as they hit wineries, sample the local cuisine, experience the culture, and live the high life in upstate New York!

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: This magnificent palace complex, situated miles away from China’s capital, was built as a summer resort for the imperial family. However, the emperor who ordered its construction had other plans in mind for this strategically placed citadel, nestled among the mountains of Hebei province. Using the palace and its vast grounds, the emperor held his power here as he did within the confines of the Forbidden City. Training with his allies, signing important treaties and strengthening his country’s status with its neighbors, this emperor not only managed to bolster his own position, but also defend his country’s borders. Discover China, as we delve deep into the Chengde Mountain Retreat’s Shielded Frontier.

programme.title: Hiking Europe-The alpe Adria Tail
programme.desc: Amid some of Europe’s most dramatic scenery, Esme reaches the mid-point of the trail, where three countries meet. She climbs to a mountain peak, tries forest bathing, and gets teased by some fish!

programme.title: Cork Screwed
programme.desc: David Johnson and Louise Engel are perfect hosts for Ralph and Pat as they teach them about the ‘birds and the lambs’- utilizing animals in the farming process. Louise hits the vineyard and showcases the farm’s Riesling grapes while David quenches the guys’ thirst for knowledge (and wine), capping it all off with their brick pizza oven!

programme.title: It's More Fun in the Philippines
programme.desc: Liü and Mel continue an amazing day island-hopping, with lunch on a sandbar, and a Jet Ski adventure, before experiencing a ‘boodle fight’ on an Eco-Park river trip.

programme.title: Destination
programme.desc: Join Alyse Edwards as she explores the beautiful Turkish town of Alacati. Located on Turkey’s west coast Alacati is stunning town, steeped in history. And with its vibrant culture Alacati certainly lives up to its reputation of being a trendy town with plenty of restaurants, shopping, historical sites and water sports.

programme.title: Destination
programme.desc: Alyse Edwards continues her journey in the Turkish town of Alacati. Starting inland she explores some of the remains of ancient civilisations and experiences some incredible views of Alacati and the surrounding areas. After a brief stop off for some exquisite wine, she heads to the nearby coastal town of Cesme for some further exploring and puts herself to the test by having a go at the famous local sport of Wind Surfing.

programme.title: Amazing Spa Towns Of Europe
programme.desc: Ellen Coughlan goes in search of natural healing and miracle water as she explores some amazing, and historic, thermal spa towns in Europe.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick and Brian travel to Newport, RI and experience everything from fresh lobster to the Gilded Age. Then set sail on a classic America's Cup 12 meter yacht.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: An age old sketching of plans for an imperial garden design drew the attention of two prominent Chinese architectural scholars. Upon further examination, they were shocked to discover he sketch’s true origins and exactly what the blueprints depicted. In their quest for more information, they unraveled the secret methods of construction for the world’s largest palace complex: The Forbidden City. From the blueprints, to small scale models, to the ingenious construction solutions conceived which brought a family, generations of success and wealth. Discover China delves into the foundations of how this impressive palace is constructed and provide detailed examination of Imperial Architectural Designs.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Looming across northern China, The Great Wall sits atop the crests, ridges and mountain tops, sprawling like a slumbering dragon. Through the ages, it has been stormed by marauding Mongolians, hailed as the ultimate defensive wall, and is one of China’s most magnificent accomplishments and first iconic image. The Great Wall has witnessed the waxing and waning of numerous dynasties and outcomes of many historic transformations. Its secrets of construction are still being uncovered, as well as revealing the stories left behind by those who constructed it. The generations, in an age where The Great Wall no longer serves its purpose, enjoys a life peace in a once threatened nation. Discover China marches across the great wall’s Wartorn Frontiers.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: All along these colorful corridors of culture, these rugged mountain roads and paths formed a lasting link between two ancient empires. Plodding through the valleys and mountains stretching out from the western reaches of mountainous Tibet to the far flung eastern China plains, these strong and sturdy horse caravans and the ancient traders and merchants who led them have helped forge an indelible cultural exchange between the two nations. As this unique odyssey continues through China’s tall and lofty mountains and rocky, winding valleys, Discover China maintains the course, following the paths of the famous Tea-Horse Silk Road.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: All along these colorful corridors of culture, these rugged mountain roads and paths formed a lasting link between two ancient empires. Plodding through the valleys and mountains stretching out from the western reaches of mountainous Tibet to the far flung eastern China plains, these strong and sturdy horse caravans and the ancient traders and merchants who led them have helped forge an indelible cultural exchange between the two nations. As this unique odyssey continues through China’s tall and lofty mountains and rocky, winding valleys, Discover China maintains the course, following the paths of the famous Tea-Horse Silk Road.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: In the west, seeking the land of Shangri-La has long been a lost cause. This work of fiction, however, seemed to have its roots in the real world, as numerous locations around Southern China bear striking resemblance to the poet’s descriptive words. In the west, over one thousand years after the poet’s story was published, a novel with remarkable similarities introduced the concept of Shangri-La to the world. Discover China, as we set out on a unique journey, seeking the Land of Peach Blossoms.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: A plethora of caves, caverns and grottoes, once served as the Chinese Nation’s gauge of political and religious stability. The sands of time are lifted to tell the tale of ancient nomadic tribes and their dominion over this land, near the city of Datong in Shanxi Province. The tribe leaders likeness’ etched for eternity onto the statues in the rocky caves symbolizing their once savage and absolute reign over China’s northwestern regions. Additionally, sing the praises for the clan’s leaders as they flourished and evolved into one of China’s earliest imperial dynasties. Discover China opens the door to the mysterious world of the Yungang Grottoes.

programme.title: Destination
programme.desc: Join Ellen Coughlan as she explores the iconic city of New Orleans. Nicknamed the “Big Easy”, it’s known for its round the clock nightlife, vibrant live-music scene, and a spicy, singular cuisine… reflecting its history as a melting pot of French, African and American cultures. New Orleans is famous for its Mardi Gras, where parades and street parties fill the city. It’s also home to the iconic Natchez Steamboat, the last completely steam powered paddleboat on the Mississippi River.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: The remains of an animal skull at JiuZhaiGou Valley in northern Sichuan Province brought about a change in mindset, proving at long last that this lush, green valley was indeed home to one of China's greatest national natural emblems – The Giant Panda. With their food supply in sharp decline, natural calamities that threaten their very existence and with a little help from human intervention, these gentle, docile giants were nearly extinct from this magical valley. However, due to some fortunate involvement by the local government, the population of this magnificent animal is finally managing to survive. Discover China as we follow the footsteps of Dong Ga – The Panda.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: In a slumbering village nestled in southeast China’s huizhou district in Anhui province, sits a mysterious hall. The village’s empty streets reveal the ancestral pride and worship that have been taking place for generations, to this very day. The village’s residents, in their unique, picturesque houses, lead a peaceful and harmonious existence, unfettered by the troubles of the world. Yet the origins of this quiet, pastoral village belie an age old story of imperial intrigue and incredible perseverance, as generations living in the village continue to commemorate their ancestors. Discover China follows the path of the mystery of the Hu Clan.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: On the lush peaks of Lu Mountain, a poet had come to continue his passion for learning. The school he had founded was later expanded by an erudite Confucian scholar, and it quickly became one of the first academic institutions in China, leading to an educational movement that lasted for more than one thousand years. The academy, called the White Deer Grotto Academy, was soon a focal point for hundreds of students and eminent teachers, where even foreign scholars were welcomed and successfully lectured, adding further luster to these ancient academic institutions. Discover China unfolds the tale of the Shuyuan – the Ancient Academies.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Through China’s distant mountains and deep, cavernous valleys, these merchants and their horse caravans have carved a path that has become a vital cultural and economic trade and commerce route. These pioneering caravans have helped forge lasting cultural and diplomatic relations between two nations for hundreds of years, led by valiant, intrepid men and their hardened, weathered beasts of burden. From the far reaches of the western Chinese plains and the distant Tibet, to the heart of the middle Kingdom’s central plains, Discover China follows in the cultural footsteps of these horse caravans, along the Tea-Horse Silk Road.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: All along these colorful corridors of culture, these rugged mountain roads and paths formed a lasting link between two ancient empires. Plodding through the valleys and mountains stretching out from the western reaches of mountainous Tibet to the far flung eastern China plains, these strong and sturdy horse caravans and the ancient traders and merchants who led them have helped forge an indelible cultural exchange between the two nations. As this unique odyssey continues through China’s tall and lofty mountains and rocky, winding valleys, Discover China maintains the course, following the paths of the famous Tea-Horse Silk Road.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: All along these colorful corridors of culture, these rugged mountain roads and paths formed a lasting link between two ancient empires. Plodding through the valleys and mountains stretching out from the western reaches of mountainous Tibet to the far flung eastern China plains, these strong and sturdy horse caravans and the ancient traders and merchants who led them have helped forge an indelible cultural exchange between the two nations. As this unique odyssey continues through China’s tall and lofty mountains and rocky, winding valleys, Discover China maintains the course, following the paths of the famous Tea-Horse Silk Road.

While primarily focusing on suspense, mystery, and psychological horror, the show also delves into elements of science fiction, fantasy, and dark comedy. Roald Dahl himself introduced the episodes in the earlier seasons, offering insight into the inspiration behind each story. The series showcases a wide range of talented actors, including notable guest stars such as John Gielgud, Joan Collins, and Derek Jacobi, among others. Tales of the Unexpected has earned a loyal following and critical acclaim for its distinctive storytelling, memorable plot twists, and its exploration of the macabre and the bizarre, making it a classic in the anthology television genre. Tales of the Unexpected is a British television series that aired from 1979 to 1988, based on a collection of short stories by the renowned author Roald Dahl.

programme.title: El Desprecio
programme.desc: In remote areas, survival is an everyday game. Enter hosts Chris and Casey Keefer as they set out to survive 30 days in the backcountry. Each new day these brothers will pit their skills as hunters, woodsmen, and fishermen against an unforgiving and relentless landscape. DROPPED brings viewers face to face with the harsh reality of only being able to eat what you can kill. A true test of survival. The Keefer brothers put boots to ground as their journey through Alaska begins. Armed with nothing but a couple Glock 20s, the brothers immediately begin their search for their first supply-yielding catch.

programme.title: El Desprecio
programme.desc: The Keefer brothers awaken to a frozen tundra. With over 8 miles to cover and no oars, the brothers are forced to trudge their way through shallow water and barren earth as they head downstream in search of their second cache.

programme.title: El Desprecio
programme.desc: Working to protect our treasured natural resources in some of the country's most secluded spots means there's never a boring day on the job.

programme.title: Bonanza 26 Denver Mckee
programme.desc: Ranchers are being killed, cattle stolen, and even after former U.S. Deputy Marshal Denver McKee sends posses after the suspects, they are never found. Meanwhile, McKee suspiciously has plenty of money to take care of his daughter and her schooling back East.

programme.title: The Law Rides Again
programme.desc: US government agents Ken Maynard and Hoot Gibson, aka "The Trail Blazers", make a deal with captured outlaw Duke Dillon to catch crooked Indian agent John Hampton, who has been using his authority to steal from the local tribe.

programme.title: I am Sartana

programme.title: A Town Called Hell

programme.title: California
programme.desc: As the California Gold Rush begins, Jonathan Trumbo (Ray Milland) goes AWOL from the Army and decides to lead a wagon train to the West Coast.

programme.title: Frontier Days
programme.desc: An undercover Wells Fargo agent attempts to root out the villain behind a series of stagecoach robberies.

programme.title: Fury 19
programme.desc: After he is taken into custody following a police fight, troubled city orphan Joey finds new purpose in his life when he moves to the Broken Wheel Ranch. programme.title: Annie Oakley 8 Annie And Silver Lace

programme.desc: Who was that masked man? The Lone Ranger, of course - sole survivor of a group of ambushed Texas Rangers, who was nursed back to health by Tonto, his trusty American Indian companion. The pair roam the Old West, defending the helpless against the forces of evil.

programme.desc: A wanted man (Douglas Dumbrille) foils cattle rustlers and helps his daughter (Charlotte Field) find true love.

programme.title: Gunslinger
